title: Baseline and remaining editing gaps
environment: WL: owned Windows Chromium and isolated test accounts
acceptance: Pin current main, map required R1 rows to existing receipts or gaps, and retain the October cumulative journey, original failures and single-device scope.
Exercise Illustrator SVG and catalog artwork through editing, grouping, undo/cancel, animation, save/reopen and export at the required zoom and with native file interactions.
Reproduce outstanding R1 issues on reachable paths before fixing them. Inventory exact GSAP artifacts and stage the written clarification request in parallel.

title: R1.2c loops
environment: BL: qualified browser preview and exported fixtures
acceptance: Verify property and layer loops, hold, interruption, replay, Out, boundaries and settling. Preserve source and legacy motion.
Verify parity with browser exports, stop on state exit, repeatable settling and continuity for supported speed changes.

title: R1.3 assisted editing and round-trip
environment: BL: browser, CLI and isolated fixtures with existing authorized model access
acceptance: Verify manual and reviewed-help flows, correct-document targeting, preview, accept, cancel, undo and safe refusal of stale requests.
Round-trip a CLI package through import, visual edit, save/reopen and export with its source and operator fields intact.
Exercise required access paths under existing model policy. Record any unresolved required access or model check.

title: R1.4 projects to rundown
environment: WL: isolated test account, disposable production and browser rehearsal
acceptance: Verify the starter or brand path, multiple durable graphics, Home reopen, selective installation and operator data, In, Next and Out.
Interrupt and retry install without duplicates, test rollback against a newer edit and preserve the live copy until explicit replacement.
Retain the October save and recovery evidence. Stage repeatable exports and a named receiving-system rehearsal before E6.

title: R1.5 software and first-use qualification
environment: WL: real first-time users, named desktop and laptop, and pinned reference
acceptance: Record two or three real first-time users completing the two release journeys. Record assistance and misses against the spec timing targets.
Measure the spec's feedback targets with native zoom where required, and execute the same tasks on the same machine against the pinned Studio reference.
Resolve release-critical gaps and stage the workflow review and receiving-system handover.

title: R1.5 receiving systems
environment: HW: real CasparCG and named OGraf renderer with a qualified operator
acceptance: On each named release host, exercise data, In, Next, Out, interruption, replay and parity with an exported graphic including a bundled font and logo.
Record the clean receiving environment, versions, actual output and compatibility scope. Use an off-air window or rehearsal output and preserve the live copy.
Checkpoint any unavailable required host or evidence with its exact next action.

title: Release decision
environment: OW: owner workflow review and recorded release decision
acceptance: Present both rehearsed workflows and the tested candidate with first-use, performance, real-host and written GSAP disposition receipts.
Record the owner's explicit release adoption decision separately from engineering passes. Release adoption requires approval and all mandatory evidence.

title: Release adoption and exact verification
environment: CI: normal GitHub merge queue, independent acceptance and production verification
acceptance: Implement the approved Alpha-to-release change for the current one-editor product, preserving routes, data, runtime and rollback.
Verify the actual merge with a fresh independent checker and all required checks, then verify the intended live deployment.
